findings.title: package move dropped public stdlib compatibility forwarding
findings.detail: After moving logging.py to logging/_logging.py, the public scikitplot.logging package re-exports __all__ but not _logging.__getattr__ or __dir__. Former calls such as scikitplot.logging.getLevelName/getLogger and dir() compatibility no longer work, while tests/shell probes still expect them.

findings.title: focused test module uses the pre-move import shape
findings.detail: logging/tests/test__logging.py uses 'from .. import logging as splog'; under scikitplot.logging.tests this asks for scikitplot.logging.logging and fails collection. A harness-only change to 'from .. import _logging as splog' yields 171/171 passing.

findings.title: focused tests preserve known defective behavior
findings.detail: The focused suite explicitly asserts that error_log is a no-op and that unknown formatter names return None, so 171/171 after import correction cannot be treated as semantic release evidence.

findings.title: error_log is still a no-op
findings.detail: _logging.error_log deletes all arguments and emits nothing.

findings.title: documented environment policy is still not applied
findings.detail: _logging.get_logger does not call _default_logging_level; SKPLT_LOGGING_LEVEL/SKPLT_VERBOSE do not configure the shared logger. SKPLT_LOGGING_AUTO_CONFIG still names no implementation.

findings.title: AlwaysStdErrHandler still cannot switch streams
findings.detail: The stream setter does not assign valid stdout/stderr values; setStream(sys.stdout) reports the old stream but remains on stderr.

findings.title: CLI/shared initialization still stacks handlers
findings.detail: _cli.logging.configure() installs one handler; subsequent _logging.get_logger() installs another on the same named logger, duplicating output.

findings.title: direct Logger call sites still lose metadata
findings.detail: The custom findCaller uses a fixed _get_caller(4) and ignores stacklevel; a direct get_logger().info call resolves to unknown file/line.

findings.title: private compatibility lookup still configures logging
findings.detail: _logging.__getattr__ says it has no side effects, but a missing stdlib attribute calls get_logger() and installs the project handler.

findings.title: unknown formatter still returns None
findings.detail: _make_default_formatter falls through for unknown strings/None instead of rejecting or returning a defined fallback.
